title: Asus, Zoom Release Security Patches
description: Asus and Zoom have released security patches addressing multiple vulnerabilities in their products. Asus fixed four high- and medium-severity flaws in certain router firmware that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges, overwrite memory, or cause crashes. Zoom patched two vulnerabilities in Workplace for Windows, including a critical unauthenticated privilege escalation bug (CVE-2026-108186) and another privilege escalation issue (CVE-2026-108187). Zoom Workplace versions 7.1.8 and later contain these fixes. There is no evidence these vulnerabilities have been exploited in the wild.
